title: Dynamic intention and specialist discovery
summary: Discovery is re-run against the current live application and specialist evidence on every turn. Availability is not permanent truth and an unavailable operation is not automatically an unknown intention.
invariants: Meaning and feasibility are separate; understood-but-currently-impossible work is INFEASIBLE rather than UNKNOWN.
Runtime-added NotNotes reports become visible on the next turn without a Help Desk code change.
Provider-owned specialist surfaces remain opaque to the Help Desk except for generic discovery/relevance/evidence contracts.
Newer management/instrumentation provider revisions do not automatically become a Help Desk execution authority.
procedure: Refresh/publish current operational evidence before discovering Instrumentation Intentions.

For infrastructure support, inject Management Intention Discovery through its generic transient specialist directory and resolve fresh relevance/evidence per request rather than adding MVS/cloud commands to Help Desk code.
Keep the accepted Help Desk baseline pinned until the new provider closure is requalified under ooRexx r13196.

provenance.claim: Per-turn NotNotes and Instrumentation specialist discovery in the accepted Help Desk implementation.
Current r13196-qualified generic management specialist discovery seam, including transient Instrumentation Mesh dev8 events/correlation/freshness evidence.
Current r13196-qualified read-only instrumentation intention provider over Instrumentation Mesh dev8.
